lines.en: Selma, look out of the window! It had been snowing all night, and the whole valley is white.
lines.pt: Selma, olhe pela janela! Tinha nevado a noite toda, e o vale inteiro está branco.

lines.en: This is amazing. In Perth we had never seen anything like this, and now the car is buried.
lines.pt: Que incrível. Em Perth nunca tínhamos visto algo assim, e agora o carro está soterrado.

lines.en: The receptionist said the road had been closed since midnight because the snow had been falling so heavily.
lines.pt: A recepcionista disse que a estrada estava fechada desde a meia-noite porque a neve vinha caindo com muita força.

lines.en: That explains why nobody came to breakfast. The staff had been trying to clear the path for two hours.
lines.pt: Isso explica por que ninguém veio ao café da manhã. A equipe vinha tentando limpar o caminho havia duas horas.

lines.en: Our hands were frozen yesterday because we had been playing in the snow without gloves, remember?
lines.pt: Nossas mãos estavam congeladas ontem porque estávamos brincando na neve sem luvas, lembra?

lines.en: Of course. I had been laughing so much that I did not notice how cold I was.
lines.pt: Claro. Eu vinha rindo tanto que nem percebi o frio que sentia.

lines.en: The ski instructor said the blizzard had been getting worse since three a.m. The forecast was wrong.
lines.pt: O instrutor de esqui disse que a nevasca vinha piorando desde as três da manhã. A previsão estava errada.

lines.en: Then let’s stay in. I had been planning to ski, but I would rather not risk it.
lines.pt: Então vamos ficar dentro. Eu vinha planejando esquiar, mas prefiro não arriscar.

lines.en: Good idea. The room is warm because someone had been keeping the fireplace going since dawn.
lines.pt: Boa ideia. O quarto está quente porque alguém vinha mantendo a lareira acesa desde o amanhecer.

lines.en: Then I will make hot chocolate. We had been looking forward to a lazy day anyway.
lines.pt: Então vou fazer chocolate quente. Estávamos mesmo ansiosos por um dia preguiçoso.

lines.en: Perfect. After we had been out in that storm yesterday, we deserve a slow afternoon.
lines.pt: Perfeito. Depois de ficarmos naquela tempestade ontem, merecemos uma tarde tranquila.

facts.label: Clima e consequências
facts.sub: Clima que durava antes de um momento passado: It had been snowing all night. Consequência: The road was closed because it had been snowing.

facts.label: Had been + -ing
facts.sub: Use had been snowing, raining ou blowing para um clima que durava antes de outro momento do passado: It had been raining all week when we arrived. A ideia é duração, não só um fato.

facts.label: Por e desde
facts.sub: Use for com um período (for ten hours) e since com um início (since midnight). Exemplo: The snow had been falling for ten hours. It had been falling since midnight. Escolha pelo que você sabe.

compare.br: Em português, “tinha nevado a noite toda” e “vinha nevando” são duas ideias diferentes.
compare.tip: Diga: “It had been snowing all night.”

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: It had been snowing shows a continuous action before a past moment.
We say “It had been snow all night”.
Since gives the starting point of the snow.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: It had been snowing shows a continuous action before a past moment. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We say “It had been snow all night”. → Falso (We say had been snowing.)
Since gives the starting point of the snow. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

pages.title: A white morning · 1/3
paragraphs: Dot and Theo come from Perth, where the winters are mild. This weekend they are staying in a small hotel in the mountains. At seven in the morning, Dot opens the curtains. A thick white layer covers the roofs and the road. Theo has never seen so much snow in his life. They need to talk about what has happened.

“Theo, look out of the window! It had been snowing all night, and the whole valley is white.” says Dot. “This is amazing. In Perth we had never seen anything like this, and now the car is buried.” says Theo. “The receptionist said the road had been closed since midnight because the snow had been falling so heavily.” says Dot.
